name: mprofit-replica
description: White-label portfolio tracker replica — Classic SPA (:5173), Analytics SPA (:5174), mock API (:3001)

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/classic && npm run typecheck -w apps/analytics
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/classic && npm run build -w apps/analytics
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w apps/classic -- --outDir ../../dist --emptyOutDir && npm run build -w apps/analytics -- --base /analytics/ --outDir ../../dist/analytics --emptyOutDir false
